summary: Define incarnation-owned synchronous driver admission gates for idle refresh

rules.detail: The shared protocol defaults to unsupported. No harness opts in and no refresh is actuated.

compatibility.detail: Existing harness behavior is unchanged. Support requires serializing every execution start with the gate.

manual.detail: No configuration or operator action is required.

recovery.detail: Closed gates require their exact incarnation, owner sequence and epoch receipt to reopen; dropping a receipt never releases a seal. Adapters must recover uncertain seals without recreating open admission.
